title: Implementation Consultant
summary: Implementation consultants set up a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product for each new customer, from the first kickoff call to go-live. They sit between the customer, sales and the product team, configuring the product, moving data in and training users.
dailyDuties: Run kickoff and discovery calls with new customers
Configure workflows, roles and rules in the product
Map and load customer data from old systems
Set up and test API or file integrations
Take customers through testing and sign-off
Track timelines and flag risks to the customer and sales
Hand customers over to support after go-live

skills.expectation: Set up a SaaS product for each customer: workflows, roles, business rules and settings, from kickoff to go-live
Run discovery calls and turn customer needs into a signed-off scope
Write test scenarios and take customers through acceptance testing and sign-off
Write SQL queries to check customer data and troubleshoot setups
Configure and debug API, webhook and file-based integrations, reading JSON payloads
Clean and map customer data from old systems into import templates
Own the implementation plan, timelines and go-live for several customers at once
Lead kickoff calls, train customer users and write clear updates
Manage customer teams, sales and product engineers through each rollout
Map the customer's current process to the product's workflow
Write onboarding guides and configuration notes
Prepare and check data templates in Excel or Google Sheets
Log product bugs in Jira and follow them to a fix
Support customers in hypercare after go-live
Keep account and project notes in the CRM

certifications.why: Helps senior consultants who run many projects
